usageNotes: Use this to check what TFA methods are configured for a specific user, both at the personal level and enforced by their realm. A user can call it for themselves; otherwise, the caller needs User.Modify or Sys.Audit on the user's group. Pass `multiple: true` to get a full array of all configured TFA types instead of just the primary one.

examples.summary: Retrieve TFA configuration for a specific user, requesting all entries as an array

tips: Without `multiple`, the response returns `user` (single legacy type) and `types` (array); with `multiple: true`, the shape changes — `user` and `types` are omitted.
The `realm` field reflects TFA enforced at the realm level (oath/yubico), which users cannot bypass regardless of their personal settings.
Note the typo in the spec enum value: `recovedry` (not `recovery`) — match this exactly if filtering on type strings.
